name: Brand Identity System
purpose: Turn an approved visual direction into an operational identity system — logo usage rules, color tokens with exact values and computed contrast, a type scale/tokens, spacing/grid rules, and iconography/imagery rules — concrete enough to build a design-token file or brief a designer directly.
triggers: BRAND_STRATEGY.md is locked and APPROVED_VISUAL_DIRECTION.md is the selected (not still-compared) visual direction
identity rules are needed before a brand book, design-token file, or component library can be built
non_triggers: generating or comparing creative territories / producing APPROVED_VISUAL_DIRECTION.md itself
random logo ideation with no direction to systematize
assembling the narrative brand book document
building individual campaign assets or a content calendar
quality_gates: every rule in IDENTITY_SYSTEM.md is operational, not descriptive prose
APPLICATION_RULES.md covers at least five surfaces, or an explicit recorded channel limitation justifies fewer
every value in DESIGN_TOKENS.json matches IDENTITY_SYSTEM.md exactly
every approved text/UI color pairing carries a computed contrast ratio meeting its stated threshold
every documented exception/forbidden-combination has a stated reason
stop_conditions: all three required artifacts produced, consistency/scalability audit passes -> COMPLETE
BRAND_STRATEGY.md missing/unlocked or APPROVED_VISUAL_DIRECTION.md missing/not a single approved grammar -> BLOCKED, state exactly which artifact/element is needed
one or more grammar elements too vague to derive concrete rules from, even via references/ methods -> PARTIAL, name the specific gaps and recommend returning to brand-visual-direction
never continue past an invented value with no trace, a token/prose mismatch, an unverified contrast claim, or fewer than five covered surfaces presented as meeting the minimum
